Commentary.Commentary: The hosts need 441 runs to win this game. Time is on their side but with the wicket deteriorating further, it won't be an easy task by any means, to say the least. A long and grueling day awaits Virat Kohli and his men. Going to be an exciting afternoon session. Join us in a short while.

India were taken for a lot of runs, 142 to be precise. They couldn't keep a lid on the runs and the wickets didn't come as quickly as they would have liked to. Ravindra Jadeja will obviously get the credit as he was stupendous, but special mention has to be given to Umesh Yadav. He has gone under the radar for some reason but the pacer was brilliant. Bowled probing line, at a venomous pace and was constantly posing questions to the Australian batsmen.

Not sure who the session has belonged to, but in the context of the game, Australia will be the happier of the two sides going into the dressing room. And it is all thanks to a superb, superb ton from skipper Steven Smith. He was given multiple lives, but take nothing away from him. On a bowling track, he was immense and powered his side to a big total. Some handy contributions from the lower middle order has helped them be in the driver's seat in this match.
So, after being made to toil hard and really work for it, India have managed to bowl Australia out for 285. That means the hosts have a target of 441 with 8 full sessions left in the Test.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Jadeja tosses it up around middle, it turns away after pitching, Steve O'Keefe presses forward to defend but the ball takes a faint outside edge as Saha behind the stumps takes a good catch. They appeal and umpire Llong raises his dreaded finger. The batsman takes the review and Ultra Edge shows little spike as the ball went past the bat. That's it, AUSTRALIA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 285! LUNCH HAS BEEN TAKEN!
Steve O'Keefe has been caught behind and given out. He has taken a review against the decision, probably just because it's available to him.
Pitches it up around middle as SOK prods forward in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy delivery around off, defended into the ground.
Tossed up around middle and off, O'Keefe comes forward and defends it down gently.
Darts it full around middle and leg, Josh works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, SOK ducks under the bumper.
Fuller on the stumps, it's drilled back to Yadav who gets his hand on it and parries it towards mid on.
FOUR! Delightful! Fuller in length and a bit too straight from Umesh, Steve O'Keefe nails the flick across the line through mid-wicket. It came off the meat of the bat.
Angles in a length ball from around off, Hazlewood looks to push it through the line but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a quick single.
Josh drives it straight to Ravindra at short extra cover.

Fuller in length and just around off, Hazlewood pushes it towards Jadeja at short extra cover. The fielder collects the ball and fires in a throw at the bowler's end and it hits. They appeal but O'Keefe drags his bat in time.
Shorter outside off, chopped in front of square on the off side.
Flatter and quicker through the air outside off, it's punched off the back foot towards extra cover.
Tossed up around off, O'Keefe comes forward to defend but gets a safe outside edge towards second slip.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fires it full and around off, Steve defends it by lunging forward.
Tossed up around off, punched off the back foot towards Kohli at short extra cover.
Fuller in length and straightens a touch after pitching, Josh plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Comes from around the wicket to the new batsman and keeps it full around off, Hazlewood defends it down solidly.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in for the visitors. Since only one wicket remains to fall, the session will be extended.

OUT! Dead plumb! Once again Yadav goes wide of the crease and angles it in from outside off, Lyon hangs back in defense but completely misses the line and is hit flush on the pads right in front of the stumps. Yadav turns back to appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in ruling it out. Yadav dismissed Lyon in a similar fashion in the first innings. Australia lead by 434 runs!
Good length ball, from wide of the crease, Nathan defends it with a straight bat.
Pitched outside off, Lyon slices it towards point.
Full delivery, stays low, angling in, Lyon defends it off the back foot.
Umesh Yadav to bowl what should be the final over before lunch.
Turn and bounce! Jadeja bowls a quicker one around off, it turns away with bounce and just whizzes past the outside edge. This should make O'Keefe lick his lips.
Short and flat outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Floats it up around off, O'Keefe comes forward to defend but the ball turns away with some bounce and he gets beaten.
Comes down the track and defends it safely.
Shorter around off, punched towards the cover fielder.
Around middle, turning away, O'Keefe defends it down safely.

SIX! Tossed up around off, Lyon slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Umesh Yadav out in the deep runs behind a little on his right and catches it, but he's going across the rope because of the momentum. Tries to throw it back in but fails to do so. Maximum!
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short and turning in on middle and leg, Steve goes back to play at it but is beaten by the quick and sharp bounce. Goes off the thigh pad and falls beside the leg slip fielder.
Loopy and turning in on middle and off, Lyon goes for the sweep but it goes off his shoulder on the on side. A leg bye is taken.
Another one on the shorter side, outside off, O'Keefe pushes it in front of covers and sets off for a run. He's finally off the mark.
Shorter, flat and on the pads, Lyon gets low and sweeps it to backward square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched towards mid off off the back foot.
Stays back and defends it with a straight bat down the wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker through the air around off, O'Keefe is beaten all ends up.
A loud shout for lbw! Quicker one around middle and leg, Nathan once again tries to sweep but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. They appeal but probably going down leg.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Lyon gets down and sweeps it in front of square to pick up a boundary.

FOUR BYES! A stumping chance goes down! Ashwin bowls a loopy delivery around off, O'Keefe comes down the track to go big on the leg side but the ball turns in sharply and goes through. Saha behind the stumps is late to react as the ball races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Gets behind the line and keeps it out.
Comes forward and defends it down gently.
O'Keefe comes down the track to defend but the ball skids through, hits him on the pads and lobs up towards short leg. Once again there was no bat involved.
A loopy full toss around off, swept towards Vijay at square leg for a single.

A loud shout for a catch, not given! Loopy ball around middle, turning in a bit, Lyon gets back to work it on the leg side but the ball goes off something towards Rahane at leg slip. They appeal but there was no inside edge.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flattish through the air around off, defended off the back foot.
Full on off, bunted back to Jadeja.
Nicely floated ball around off, it turns away sharply as O'Keefe prods forward to defend but is beaten by the sharp away turn there.
Lyon fetches it from outside off and sweeps it through square leg for one.
Full and fired around off, Lyon defends it off the front foot towards silly point.
Nathan Lyon is the new man in for Australia.

OUT! In the air... taken! Ashwin once again tosses it up around off, Starc gets down on one knee to slog sweep it but doesn't get enough meat this time. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket where KL Rahul comes running in and takes a good catch. Starc departs and Ashwin finally gets a wicket today.
Starc gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.

SIX! In the arc for Starc and he sends it out of the park! Ash gives a bit more flight around middle and off, Mitchell reads it early, clears his front leg and thumps it over mid-wicket for another maximum. his third of this innings.
Loopy ball around middle and off, MS defends it off the back foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Starc gets down to sweep but gets beaten.
Loopy ball around off, Starc lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up delivery around off, Steve O'Keefe presses forward and defends it in front of silly point.
Full outside off, another front foot defense from O'Keefe.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floats this one up around off, it's kept out off the front foot on the off side.
Turning around off, beats the outside edge as the batsman comes forward to defend.
Flatter and shorter on the stumps, it's worked to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Starc pushes this full ball towards mid off.
Floats it up outside off, Starc lunges forward to defend but once again the ball turns away and beats his outside edge.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! Wallop! Floats it up around off, Starc sits down on one knee and launches this one over long on for a maximum all the way. Expect a few more from him now.
Presses forward to this full ball and defends it down gently.
Tossed up on off, Starc comes forward to defend but the ball turns away to beat his outside edge.
Full and around off, turning away as Steve gets beaten on the front foot defense.
Steve O'Keefe walks into the middle next.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Smith has to walk back but not before playing a wonderful knock! A possible match-winning ton in every sense! Tossed up around off, it spins in sharply as Smith tries to swipe it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. A loud appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger. Smith takes the review and replays show it was in line and would have gone on to crash the stumps. Smith walks back amidst loud cheers. Australia lead by 401! Also, this was Jadeja's 100th wicket in India.
Steven Smith is caught leg before and adjudged out. But the Aussie skipper has decided to review the decision.
A low full toss around off, Starc milks it down to long on for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Starc mistimes his punch back to the bowler.
Floated ball around off, pushed towards the point fielder for a single. Lead is 400 now!
Tossed up outside off, it turns miles after pitching, Smith comes forward to defend but gets beaten completely.
From around the wicket, tossed up on off, Starc punches it towards the extra cover fielder who moves to his right to collect it.
Loopy and fullish in length, around off, swept through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Around off, Smith gets an outside edge as he plays at it. It runs down to third man as the batsmen take two runs.
Spinning in from around off, Steven Smith turns this to the on side for nothing.
Another shout for a leg before but the impact was way outside off. Tossed up around off, Smith missed his sweep shot and was hit on the back pad.
Full around off, Mitchell pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! That is huge! Tossed up around off, Starc sees it's in his slot as he sits down and murders the slog sweep over long on for a maximum. The lead is touching 400 now!
Outside off, turning in a bit, Starc doesn't play at it.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Starc gets back and cuts it beautifully through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, Smith pushes it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Smith tries to play it with soft hands but gets an outside edge which falls short of the second slip fielder.
Once again presses forward to defend but the ball bites through the surface and he gets beaten again.
Beaten all ends up! Tossed up around off, it turns away after pitching, Starc prods forward to defend but gets beaten by the sharp away turn there.
Full and outside off, Smith gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Attempts a reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW is not given as it was pitched just outside the line.
Full and going down leg, Smith works it towards long leg and gets a brace.
Nicely tossed up around middle and off, Smith covers the line and defends it well.
Ravichandran Ashwin returns to the attack. Didn't have a good first spell. Can he do better in this one?
Tossed up around off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
18th Test century for Steven Smith!

There it is! Boy, he is up and running! He knows the value of this knock! Removes the helmet, punches the air in joy and raises his bat towards the dressing room and takes the acknowledgement on offer! Though he has gotten some reprieves but you need caliber to make the most of it! Well played, Smudge! A bit short and outside off, Smith punches it through covers and always wanted a double. Gets it easily in the end!
Around off, it turns away after pitching, Smith looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
Tossed up around middle and off, SS defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Moves to 98! Flatter and quicker through the air around off, Smith gets back, waits for the ball to come and then cuts it really late past backward point for a boundary.
Full and floated around off, Smith comes forward and defends.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
In the air... safe! Angles in a length ball from around off, Mitchell looks to push it towards mid on. It goes aerially but is lucky as the ball falls well short of Jayant there.
Edged but safe! Fuller length delivery, in that zone outside off, Starc tries to poke at it but gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce towards Rahane at gully.
Angling in on middle, tucked through square leg for an easy single.
Angles in a length ball from around off, Smith covers the line and keeps it out with a straight bat.
Good length delivery on off, Smith defended off the back foot.
Flatter through the air around off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single. This is Smith's highest score against India in India.
SS has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten! Loopy delivery around off, it grips through and turns away after pitching, Smith comes forward to defend but the ball just goes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Quicker around middle and off, Smith hangs back in defense.
Tossed up around off, Smith defends it off the front foot.
Fires it full around  middle and off, Smith comes down the track, takes it on the full and defends it towards the leg side.
Ravindra Jadeja is back into the attack!

FOUR! A bit too full and Starc has pounced on it. Extremely full outside off, Starc uppishly drives it through extra cover and finds the gap well. It rockets away to the fence as the left-hander gets his first boundary of the innings.
No run.Angling in on off stump, it's kept out with the full face of the bat in front of covers.
Oh, that's excellent bowling. At 141 kph, it straightens up from around off on an excellent length, beats Starc hands down as it once again just goes past the outside edge.
Switches the angles again and hurls in a length ball around off, it's angling in first but then just straightens up a shade. It whiskers past the outside edge as Starc attempts to push.
Over the wicket now, shortish into the body, Smith swivels across and pulls it down to fine leg for one run.
From around the wicket, Umesh bangs in a short of a length delivery and angles it in to Mitchell Starc, the southpaw hops and works it down on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven through to long off for a single and that will be the end of the over.
Plays this with the spin and turns it to the square leg area for a run.
Turning in a bit on middle and off, pushed slightly quicker through the air as well, Smith is caught very high on the thigh pad as he attempts to play at it.
Another one on the shorter side, Starc stands tall and punches it to the cover region for a single.
Short, flat and coming in, Steven Smith pulls it through to deep square leg for one run.
FOUR! Full toss on off, Smith drives it through the covers nicely and gets another boundary to his name.
Mitchell Starc is the new man in, replacing Wade! He played a handy knock in the first innings, can he do it again?
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! This time he's gone. The noise was quite loud and he's going to have to walk back. Karma, as some would say. Umesh Yadav from around the wicket hurls it on a fuller length in the off stump channel, Wade looks to play the booming drive but gets an edge. Saha fumbles first but then collects it. Australia lose another wicket and lead by 359 runs.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Fuller length delivery from over the wicket, shaping away from around, Smith reaches out to it and gets an edge behind square on the off side. One run taken.
Angling in on a fuller length, it's worked through mid-wicket for a single.

Was there an edge? There was some noise, and there was nothing else around the ball besides the bat. Think umpire Kettleborough has got this one wrong. Length delivery in the channel outside off, on a good length, Wade has a tame feel for it and Saha appeals as the ball thuds into this gloves. India appeal but there's no response from the umpire. Snicko shows that there was indeed an edge. Wade is a lucky man.
Length delivery around off, it's pushed away off the front foot in front of covers.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short fine leg.
Around middle and leg, Smith gets down to sweep but gets an inside edge as Rahane at leg slip dives to his right to stop that one.
Smith gets back and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on the stumps, worked with the spin towards square leg.
Slides it around middle and leg, Smith pads it away.
Jayant oversteps! Loopy ball around off, Wade pushes it towards covers and takes a single.
Tossed up around middle, Smith comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully driven! Fuller and served a bit wide outside off, Wade leans into it and caresses it through covers for a boundary. It sped away to the fence!

A loud shout for a catch, nothing from Kettleborough! Yadav bangs in a short ball outside off, Wade looks to pull this one but the ball goes off something to the keeper. The Indians put in an appeal but it's turned down by the umpire. Replays show that came off the helmet. Good decision!
Fuller on the leg stump, Wade gets across and keeps it out.
Fuller and coming in a bit, MW defends it solidly off the front foot.
Angles across a length ball around off, Wade covers the line and defends it down.
Good length ball outside off, punched through the line towards cover-point for a single. Australia now lead by 350!
Matthew Wade has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around off, defended off the front foot.
Finds the gap this time, clips it just in front of square and gets a run.
Once again Smith works it away on the leg side. Gets it past second slip but the fielder from square leg comes across to cut it off. Save the run for his side.
Stays right behind the line and blocks.
Spinning in to Steven Smith on a shorter length, he turns it past the vacant short leg position for no run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Back of a length into the body, Wade swivels across and pulls it behind square. Rahul in the deep comes running across to his left and fires a throw as he tumbles. Is a bit sloppy in doing so and this allows the batsmen to come back for the second. Rahul is however holding his shoulder once again, seems to still be in some pain.
Bit too straight as Umesh bowls this on middle and leg, it's flicked through the mid-wicket region for a couple of good runs.
Angles a length delivery across, it's not bothered with by Matthew Wade.
Full and well outside off, good use of the hands as Steven Smith just pushes it through point to pick up an easy single.
Fractionally fuller than a length, around off, Smith leans ahead a touch and plays it back down the track.
Loopy and full from Jayant, Matthew from deep inside his crease sees it out with a straight bat.
FOUR! Shot. Short, flat and wide outside off, Wade camps back and cuts it through point to send it all the way for a boundary.
Fuller and flatter around the off stump, no problem for Wade to keep it out on the off side.
Holds his ground inside his crease and keeps it out with the full face of the bat.
A good amount of turn for Jayant, he flights it on off, it's spins away and beats the outside edge as Wade looks to defend.
Darts it full and flat outside off, Wade leaves it alone.
A length ball, coming in a bit, Smith looks to slash it through the line but the ball stays a bit low and he gets beaten.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Wade tucks it towards square leg. It seemed like it came off the pads but the umpire signals it as run.
Fuller in length and curling back in from around off, Wade presses forward and blocks it down the track.
On a length and just outside off, Smith punches it towards covers for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, Steven defends it off the front foot.
Starts with a length delivery just around off, Smith stays in his crease and defends it down.
Umesh Yadav is brought into the attack now!
Finally a bit of turn for Jayant. He floats this outside off, it spins away a touch as the left-hander leaves it alone.
Extremely full on the stumps, Matthew Wade keeps bat and pad close together and presents a tight defensive shot.
Sliding in on off, the southpaw positions himself behind the line and blocks.
No turn for Jayant Yadav once again, easily dealt with by Matthew Wade.
No turn on that occasion, it just holds its line as Wade hangs back and defends it down into the track.
Starts off from around the wicket and tosses it up outside off, it's pushed away past the vacant silly point position.
Jayant Yadav into the attack now!
Brings out the broom once again, sweeps it through square leg and picks up a single.
Stifled appeal for a leg before, not given. Coming in on middle and leg, Wade misses his sweep shot and is hit on the front pad.
Flatter ball in that off stump channel, it's kept out off the front foot.
From over the wicket, it's a bit full in length around off, Wade kneels across and sweeps it behind square. Runs hard and hence is able to make it back in time for the second. Nicely done.
Turning away on a length, outside off, it's punched away through point for a single.
Floats it around off, Smith with a solid front foot defense.
Quicker one outside off, Wade shoulders his arms to that one.
On middle and leg, Smith works it towards square leg for a single.
Turns in from around middle and leg, Steven works it towards the on side.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side.
Flatter through the air around off, Smith goes back and punches it towards mid on.
Slider around middle and leg, Wade clips it towards square leg for a quick single.
FOUR! Great use of the feet from Smith, the intent is good. He dances down and lofts it over mid-wicket to send it across the rope for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stays right behind the line of this one and blocks it out.

Close shave! It's sliding in on a fuller length from around off, Smith prods forward to block and ensure to keep bat and pad close together. There's a shout for an lbw but it's turned down. Replay show it was pad first and Smith would have been a goner here.
Similar delivery, Steven Smith from deep inside his crease with it with a straight blade.
Sliding in from around off, it is blocked.
Floated delivery around off, Matthew defends it off the front foot.
Lunges forward to this full ball and blocks it out.
Gripping in sharply from around middle, Smith works it delicately past Rahane at leg gully for one.
Flatter one around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around middle, Smith once again comes down the track and defends.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Smith comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Turning in to Wade, he works this straight to short leg. It goes to him on the bounce.
This time Smith works it to backward square leg and picks up a single.
Tossed up just outside off, Wade kneels down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Darts it quick and full on off, Matthew Wade plants his front foot forward to block.
Matthew Wade is the new man in, replacing Marsh!

OUT! Edged and taken! Good take by Wriddhiman Saha behind the stumps. Jadeja bowls it on a fuller length around off, it turns a bit as Mitchell Marsh presses forward to block. It takes a faint edge as the keeper behind collects it nicely in his gloves. Beautiful delivery, early breakthrough for India. Australia lead by 324 runs.

FOUR LEG BYES! Jadeja comes from wide of the crease and drops it on leg stump, it turns a long way as the ball beats the outside edge, goes off the back thigh pad and races away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, Smith sweeps it straight to the man at square leg.

FOUR! Past the leg slip! Loopy delivery around middle, it turns in sharply after pitching, Smith gets back to work it on the leg side but the ball goes off the gloves towards leg slip. Rahane there dives to his right but the ball seems to have gone off his fingers and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up as well.
Tossed up on off, MM comes forward and pushes it towards point for one.
Keeps it full around off, nudged towards long on for a single.
Kohli is having a word with Ashwin here.
In that off stump channel, Mitchell Marsh stays inside his crease and pushes it a bit square on the off side.
Another dot ball as MM goes ahead and pushes it away on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another one on the fuller side, Mitchell Marsh with a big stride forward to block.
Floated just outside off, Marsh is well forward and defends it on the off side.
Some decent air on that, Smith gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to wide long off for one run.
Off spinner which hasn't really turned, Marsh plays this inside the line and is beaten.
A bit of flight around off, it's played back to the bowler.
Bowls this on the stumps, Marsh gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to play at it. Naturally the lbw appeal is turned down.
Tossed up delivery on off, the batsman prods forward and blocks.
Sweeper cover in place now...
FOUR! Poor ball which is punished by Mitchell Marsh. It's short and well outside off, he moves across a bit and punches it through the covers for a boundary.
Turning in from around off, the Aussie skipper works it to backward square leg for one.
Marsh stays back to this shorter delivery and ends the over without any damage.
Fullish in length around off, blocked.
A bit slower through the air, on off, Marsh hangs his bat and gets an outside edge. It falls just short of the second slip fielder.
Another leading edge. It stays a bit low and goes on straight, Smith gets a leading edge past the slip fielders and picks up a single for it.
Turning away from Steven Smith, he hangs his bat out to defend but is beaten past the outside edge.
Quicker one around off, Smith closes the face of the bat a bit too early and gets a leading edge on the off side.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven to mid on.
Another front foot defense from Mitchell as he comfortably deals with it.
Fullish in length and around off, he comes forward and drops it on the off side.
Plenty of flight on this occasion as Ashwin bowls this on a length, Mitchell Marsh goes back to block.
FOUR! Nicely put away. Short and wide outside off, Marsh stands tall and crunches it through point to get a boundary to his name.
Tossed up nicely from Ashwin, Steven Smith comes down the track and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Dot ball to end the over. Jadeja bowls a slider on off, Mitchell Marsh meets it with a straight bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Looped up on off, Marsh stays behind the line and comes ahead to defend.
Bowls this just ahead of a length, around off, Mitchell Marsh defends solidly.

Loud shout for lbw but it's turned down. Quicker one coming in from middle and off, Marsh comes forward to defend but is rapped on the pads. But the appeal is turned down as the ball was probably going down leg.
Venomous bounce straightaway. Ripper from Jadeja. He tosses it up around off, it bites off the surface and spins past the outside edge, shoots straight to the slip fielder in fact.
Ravindra Jadeja to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up on the stumps, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, pushed towards point for a single. Wonder why is there no slip for Marsh.
Quicker around middle, swept through square leg for one.

NOT OUT! Floats it up around off, Smith looks to glide it towards backward point but gets it off the outer part of the bat. Steven wants to come back for second as Jayant Yadav fires in a throw at the striker's end. Saha collects the ball and whips the bails off as Smith dives to get back in. They appeal for a run out and it's taken upstairs. Replays show the Aussie skipper has made it in, a couple of runs taken. Lead is now 300!
A run out appeal against Smith is taken upstairs!
Loopy around middle, turning in as well, Smith gets back and defends it down towards short leg.
Starts with a floated ball around off, Smith defends it from the crease.

Right... All set to get things rolling. Steven Smith and Mitchell Marsh stride out to the middle with the intent of building up their lead even more. Ravichandran Ashwin will fire away with the ball first up. Here we go...

Pitch Report - Shane Warne says the cracks are starting to open up. Sunil Gavaskar adds that it will make the batting a bit more difficult. Continues saying it's like a dust bowl and that the bowlers should bowl on a back of a length, more of where Josh Hazlewood frequently bowls. Warne ends by saying that today will be an excellent day of Test cricket and India will fightback hard for sure.

Hello and a warm welcome for the day 3 of this Test match between India and Australia. The Aussies are bossing the game at the moment after bundling out India cheaply yesterday, and now have swelled their lead to 298. Captain Smith has registered his fifty and come this day, would look to add quick runs before handing the willow to the hosts. The pitch is going to deteriorate further and batting last on this wicket is never going to be easy. Can the Indians fightback or will Australia continue to strengthen their position in this Test? Let's see how the day unfolds.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1...

Day 3 is set up to be an interesting one. Australia already have a big score on the board. They'll look to further it at a brisk rate. India on the other hand, will obviously want to get them out early and have a go with the bat. Do join us for it. Till then, cheers!

India did make some inroads but it wasn't enough. Their fielding would be something they will rue dearly. Dropping Steven Smith of all people, that too three times, is not excusable at all. That has haunted them as the Aussie skipper has cruised along. Ravichandran Ashwin scalped 3 out of the 4 wickets and was brilliant, while Jayant Yadav took the last one.

30 overs, 97 runs and 2 wickets - Thoroughly Australia's day today. They dominated with the ball first via a stupendous bowling display from Steve O'Keefe who took 6/35, and now, have set themselves up in a commanding position in this match with the bat. Steven Smith the man to step up for Australia. He made a solid fifty and had help from Matt Renshaw first, and now from his current partner Mitchell Marsh. The visitors lead by 298 runs and are primed to motor along further.
Loops this up outside off, Marsh pushes it towards point. AND IT'S STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Full delivery, Marsh's front foot defense goes onto hit his pads.
Faster and spinning away, Marsh is caught on two minds and decides to leave it in the end.
Marsh goes forward and defends this tossed up delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Jadeja draws Marsh by offering flight and beats him on the bounce. Beautiful delivery, deserved a wicket.
Ravindra Jadeja is back into the attack.
Ends the over with an extremely full delivery, on off, comfortably dealt with by Steven Smith after covering the line.
Good length delivery just around off, shaping back in, Smith covers the line well and keeps it out solidly.
Slower one from Ishant, he bowls it on a length outside off, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.
Full and swinging back in from around off, Steven Smith leans ahead and buries the ball in the track.
Good length delivery just around off, Smith leans ahead and defends.
Back of a length delivery outside off, with width on offer Mitchell Marsh cuts it away through backward point for a single.
Good length ball, outside off, Smith leaves it alone.
Fuller length delivery, fourth stump line, Smith knocks it back to the bowler.
Lands this on a length, Smith lets it through. And Saha fails to collect it as it goes to him on the third bounce.
On a length outside off, Marsh creams it through covers for a single.
Bowls a full length delivery, on off, Marsh defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery around off, Marsh knocks it towards the off side.
Umesh Yadav comes back into the attack.
Fullish delivery, on the sticks, Marsh opens the face of the bat and taps it to covers. One run added to the total!
Fuller and slower, Marsh reads it early and defends it.
Back of a length around off, Marsh pushes it towards the off side.
A short leg has been deployed.
Back of a length delivery, Marsh pats it towards point and wants a run. Smith says no.
On a length around off, Marsh blocks it towards covers.
Full length ball, on the sticks, Marsh drives it towards mid off.
Ishant Sharma is brought back into the attack.
Shortish delivery on the sticks, Smith pushes it towards the bowler.
Smith knocks this floated delivery back to the bowler.
Smith goes forward to defend but gets beaten on the turn.
This one stays low and whistles past Smith's willow. Had it been on the stumps, he could've been in danger.
Short and flatter, Smith goes back and defends it.
Tosses this one around off, Smith drills it through covers for a single.
Bowls this on the pads, Marsh tucks it away to fine leg and runs one.
Smith uses his feet and flicks this fullish delivery through mid-wicket for a single.
Sprays this down the leg side, Marsh moves across and glances it through fine leg. One run added to the total!
Marsh goes ahead and defends this on the leg side.
Faster delivery on the sticks, Marsh calmly buries it.
Bowls a fuller length ball, Smith eases it through mid on for a single.
Tosses this one outside off, Marsh pushes it towards covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter delivery, Marsh goes back and pushes it towards the point region.
Bowls this towards the leg side, Marsh blocks it.
Marsh goes forward and defends this looped up delivery.
Tossed up outside off, Marsh goes forward to drive but is beaten. Saha whips the bails off and a referral has been taken, but Marsh's foot is quite comfortably in.
A stumping decision against Mitchell Marsh is taken upstairs to the third umpire.
Tosses this on around leg, Smith lets it through.
Smith comes out to reach the pitch of the ball and flicks to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one on leg, Marsh shuffles and tucks it away for a single.
SIX! Marsh comes down the ground and whacks this looped up delivery over long on. Some excitement for fans in the stands who aren't throwing the ball back.
Lands this full and on middle, Marsh moves across and blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Sprays this down the leg side, Smith glances it away through backward square leg for a single.
Marsh looks to defend but it takes the leading edge and goes towards point.
Bowls this slower in the air, Marsh goes ahead and the ball spins away to beat him.
Tossed up around off, Marsh blocks it away.
Marsh lunges forward and buries this right under his eye line.
Jadeja draws Marsh forward to defend and spins it away.
Smith drives this looped up delivery through covers for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja back on to bowl.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
FOUR! Marsh smacks Jayant down the ground, who tries to stop it but fails.
Full delivery, Marsh goes back and blocks it.
Marsh prods forward and dead-bats this floated delivery.

NOT OUT! Kohli takes another review in desperation more than anything. Smith looks to sweep this tossed up delivery and misses. It hits on his front pad, the first look suggests that it is missing the leg. But the captain takes a risk and reviews it. Replays clearly suggest it's going down the leg. They run a leg bye.
Steven Smith was caught on the pads and adjudged not out. Virat Kohli, however, want to review the decision. Looks to be sliding down the leg side to the naked eye.
Lands this fuller around off, Smith looks to defend, it takes the leading edge and goes through point. They run a couple.
Short delivery, outside off, Marsh gets out of its way and lets it through.
Lands it full again on middle, Marsh looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and rolls towards mid off and mid on.
On a length, around middle, Marsh drives it to the mid on fielder.
FOUR! Mitch Marsh gets off the mark with a boundary. Full delivery around off, he drills it past the diving short cover fielder and off she goes to the cover fence.
Marsh leans forward and pushes this length ball towards covers.
Length delivery, outside off, Marsh looks to push but it takes the inside edge and goes onto to hit his pads.
Ishant Sharma is back into the attack.

NOT OUT! India waste yet another review. Marsh looks to defend it but misses and it raps his front pad. Kohli reviews it after a brief thought. Impact remains umpire's call and the replays indicate it was going over the middle stump. They run a leg bye.
An lbw appeal against Mitchell Marsh is reviewed by India.
Marsh goes to defend but it hits his pads and flies in the air. But it lands well ahead of the FSL.
Loops this one around middle which spins away, Marsh stands tall and leaves it alone through the leg side.
Smith tucks it away through square leg and runs one.
A huge appeal for LBW as Smith looks to sweep this tossed up delivery. But the umpire turns it down.
Mitchell Marsh is the next man in.

OUT! Why? There was absolutely no need to play that. And you can clearly see that from the southpaw's expression who is in utmost disbelief. Flighted delivery, around off, Renshaw comes down the ground and lofts it high up in the air. Ishant Sharma runs across from long off and cups it comfortably. Australia lead by 268 runs.
Short of a length delivery, around middle and leg, Smith punches it to mid on.
21st Test fifty for Steven Smith!

FOUR! Bowls this down the leg side, Smith shuffles across and flicks this through fine leg for a boundary. An innings full of hard work and application. Captain's knock from Smudge. That also brings up the 50-run partnership between Renshaw and Smith.
Full length delivery, swinging away, Renshaw looks to flick but it takes the outside edge and goes through point. One run added to the total!
Marginally ahead of length, around off, Renshaw drives it towards covers.
On a length, fifth stump line. Renshaw looks to flirt with it but it whizzes past him.
Length delivery, outside off, Renshaw shoulders his arms.
Drinks have been called.
Tossed up, Smith blocks it off his back foot.
Renshaw reverse sweeps again, this time through second slip and runs one.

FOUR! DROPPED! Nothing is going India's way. Renshaw reverse sweeps this tossed up delivery and it comes off his top edge. It was Vijay at second slip who put his hand forward to take it and it went past Rahane at first slip. Kohli must be fuming as that not only cost them a wicket but also a boundary.
Smith charges down the track and flicks it uppishly in front of square for a single.
Offers flight on off, Renshaw looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and goes towards covers. They run a single.
Tosses this one around leg, Smith tucks it through fine leg for a single.
Bowling change! Jayant Yadav is brought into the attack.
Fullish length, fired across, blocked from within the crease on the off side.
Slanted across the left-hander, it's dabbed square on the off side with an open face.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Matty Renshaw stands his ground and meets it with a solid, straight bat.
Length ball around off, it's pushed away to the covers for a single.
Tailing back in on middle and leg, it's flicked away to the leg side for nothing.
Umesh Yadav with a fast ball on the stumps, at 144 kph, he bowls it full and Steven Smith gets behind the line to defend.
Renshaw once again gives the charge and whips it through mid-wicket. Jadeja out in the deep cuts it off and the batsmen take two.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Renshaw uses his height well, comes forward and wrists it to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! He played shots like these against Jadeja in the first innings, now he's doing it against Ashwin. He skips out and lofts it over the mid on fielder for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Now from around the wicket, Ashwin floats it up on middle and leg, it's too straight as Renshaw flicks it through the mid-wicket region. It races away to the fence for a boundary.
Outside off, Steven Smith helps it down to third man for a comfortable run.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Angling away from the southpaw, Renshaw plays this inside the line and is beaten past the outside edge.
Fires this in full and attacks the stumps, Matt leans ahead and dead-bats it.
On a back of a length, outside off, Renshaw stands tall and defends.
Angling in on middle and leg, worked away to square leg for one.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Back of a length delivery well outside off, Smith walks across and then flays it behind backward point to pick up a boundary.
Loopy around off, Renshaw comes ahead and survives the over with a front foot block.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. Gets no run for it, though.
Fullish around off, kept out off the front foot.
Walks out to this one and turns this one 'round the corner. A single is taken.

Dropped! Now this he should have taken! Oh, dear... Full on middle and leg, Smith steps out and flicks it away in the air. It goes off his pads and then to short leg where Abhinav Mukund drops an easy one. Catches win you matches and today, this lad might learn that valuable lesson the hard way.
Bowls it slower through the air on middle and off, Smith comes ahead and blocks.
Excellent length delivery on middle and off, Matt Renshaw stays behind the line and defends it with a straight blade.

Matt Renshaw gets hit on his right forearm and the physio is out. Not only that, he is also vomiting. Seems his sickness is really getting to him. He's in a bit of trouble here. The physio needs to take a call whether he should continue further. And looks like he will. Good to see!

That didn't bounce at all. And has caught Matty Renshaw on his right forearm. That must have hurt, he seems to be in real pain. Umesh bangs it in hard on middle and leg, it doesn't bounce as much as it should. Renshaw who was looking to duck is struck on his hand. He's down in agony there.
Fullish in length and around off, it's pushed straight to the extra cover fielder.
Brilliant line. Umesh is straightaway on the money. Bowls an excellent length delivery in that off stump channel, keeps a little low as Renshaw brings his bat down to keep it out.
Hurls across a length delivery well outside off, Renshaw hangs his bat out to defend but is beaten past his outside edge.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, it's worked away to the square leg region for a single.
After 27 overs of spin, finally some rest for the spinners and us. Umesh Yadav comes into the attack!
Steve Smith has looked very settled at the centre. It is important for India to get him quickly if they want to bounce back  into the game.
Carrom ball from Ravi Ash, Steven Smith however tucks it to square leg for a run.
On the pads, Matt nudges it fine down the leg side and picks up a single for doing so.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR.Excellent last second adjustment from Matty Renshaw. Ashwin bombs it full on middle, it's a yorker really as Renshaw gets down to it. He somehow manages to get his bat on it and good that he did, otherwise he would have been gone. it actually runs away down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Uses the angle well as Ashwin floats it on middle stump, turns a lot as Renshaw comes forward. Goes off the edge past the silly point fielder.
Ashwin from around the wicket tosses it up on middle and off, Renshaw comes forward and defends.
Attacking the stumps on a fuller length, comfortably dealt with by Matt Renshaw.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floats this up around off, Matt strides ahead and pushes it out.

FOUR! Good shot from Renshaw. Even though it wasn't totally under control, he did enough to get it away. Tossed up around off, Matt gets it off the bottom edge as he attempts to reverse sweep. It goes past the keeper and the first slip fielder and races away to the fence.
No run.Darts this full on the stumps, Renshaw steps out and plays it back to the bowler.
Full on the stumps, it's worked in front of short leg.
Flights this delivery around middle and leg, Renshaw waits for the turn but gets an inside edge which goes towards square leg. They run through for a single.
Renshaw tries to sweep but is struck on the pads.
Renshaw reverse sweeps Ashwin on the turn as the second slip stops it. The other fielder chases it and allows no run.
Tossed up delivery, on the sticks, Renshaw knocks this back to the bowler.
Loops this up on off, Renshaw blocks it towards the leg side.
Tosses this one around off, Renshaw leans forward and buries it.
Another one on the fuller side, it's defended with the full face of the bat.
Full around off, Smith blocks it by coming ahead.
Sliding in on middle and off, blocked by getting behind the line.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! RENSHAW SURVIVES! A good review Renshaw and Smith. Tossed up from around the wicket, around off, it's turning in and catches Renshaw on the back pad. There are shouts for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Renshaw consults with skipper and takes the review. Replays shows the ball to be going over the stumps and the southpaw is safe.
Matt Renshaw has opted for a review after being given out.
Shouts for a leg before but the umpire interested. Floated around off, turns in and catches Renshaw on the front pad as he looks to flick. Possibly was going down leg.
Shorter and slower, Smith stands firm and punches through covers for a brace.
Smith leans forward and dead-bats this looped up delivery.
Renshaw works it around through square leg for a single.
Renshaw reverse sweeps this tossed up delivery and Jayant Yadav makes a sharp save at point.
Renshaw blocks this floated delivery with his pad.
Gives the ball some flight, Renshaw is aware and lets it through.
Comes forward to this flighted delivery and smothers the ball in its tracks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Not out! Flighted outside off, Smith has a poke at it and gets an edge. It goes right between first and second slip and it runs to third man. Smith quickly runs back the second and dives full stretch to get in. Saha removes the bails and the decision goes upstairs. Replays show that the Australia captain has comfortably made his ground.
The umpire has gone up for a run out against Smith.
Similar ball, same result. Steven Smith is beaten for the third time on the trot.
Was there an edge? Seems like there wasn't, Kohli seems convinced. Tossed up around off, invites Smith forward and it goes past the outside edge. The noise came off the bat hitting the ground.
Floats this just back of a driving length, around off, it's turning away and beats the outside edge of Steven Smith's bat.
Matt Renshaw will be the new man in.

OUT! Finally, Ashwin breaks the partnership. Bowls this slower through the air, Handscomb camps back looking to tuck it away, but it takes the inside edge, hits his thigh pad and flies towards Vijay at leg slip who cups it easily. The extra bounce got him there! Australia lead by 216 runs.
Loops this up around off, PH defends it.
Bowls this one around off, Smith sweeps it towards fine leg. Single taken!
Looped up delivery, outside off, PH drives it through mid off. One run added to the total!
Smith comes down the track and clips it through mid-wicket and runs one.
Tosses this on middle and leg, Handscomb flicks it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up by Jadeja, it's buried into the track to end the over.
Fuller around off, Steven Smith brings bat and pad close together to ensure that the ball falls right down on the track off his bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushed quicker through the air, around off, Smith is forward and defends.
Darts it right on the stumps, it's kept out off the front foot and into the track ahead.

Dropped! But that was a difficult chance for the substitute fielder Mukund. Fuller around off, Smith dances down and lofts it towards mid on. Mukund dives to his right and gets his hands to it, but cannot hold on to it. No run taken though.
Another one tossed right up there, blocked solidly to end the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Full outside off, Handscomb drives it through the covers and sends it across the ropes for a boundary.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's driven down to long on for a single.
Steven Smith dances down the wicket and ensures that he blocks it out.
Full on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length, it's turned enough and beaten Smith as he went back to play at it.
Turn and bounce for Jadeja. Tossed up around off, Smith comes forward to play at it but is beaten past the outside edge. Was some extra bounce on that occasion as well.
Looped up around off, Smith presses and dead-bats it into the track ahead.
Quicker one pushed through outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Full outside off, Smith pushes it square on the off side off the front foot.
Ravindra Jadeja to bowl from the other end.
Flatter and quicker, Handscomb offers a front foot defense.
Handscomb knocks this flighted delivery back to the bowler.
Was it a catch? No, it wasn't. It came off Handscomb's thigh pad. Handscomb looks to tuck Ashwin's floated delivery but it hits his thigh pad and goes towards leg slip.
FOUR! Handscomb dances down the ground and flicks this looped up delivery uppishly through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Slower through the air, PH leans forward and buries it.
Tosses this one around off, Smith eases it through mid on for a single.

The players are out at the centre. It goes without saying that this is a very crucial session for India. Steven Smith and Peter Handscomb too have arrived at the crease. Will Kohli continue with spin? Yes, he will! The captain tosses the ball to Ashwin.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

India have done reasonably well in this little period. Got two wickets and could have had one more, that of Smith, but it was a difficult chance and would be harsh to blame Vijay for it. 46 runs have been conceded and the visitors have swelled their lead to 201. Should be a thrilling final session. Join us in a very, very short while.

That went by really quickly, didn't it? Phew! Australia are currently cruising along and doing so quite nicely. Having a lead of 155, the Aussies lost David Warner in the first over itself. Then Shaun Marsh departed soon after and both were scalped by Ashwin. They've gotten themselves till the break with no more wickets as Steven Smith is looking solid with Peter Handscomb partnering him in the middle.
Slider coming in on middle and off, Handscomb keeps it out by getting right behind the line. TEA ON DAY 2!
Darts this one of the stumps, it's blocked.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
In the off stump channel, Peter tries to put bat on ball but is beaten as the ball grips off the deck and goes past the edge.
Another one outside off, Peter has nothing to do with that one.
Turning away from Peter Handscomb on a driving length, it's left alone.
Around off, another defensive shot to end the over.
FOUR! Lovely innovation from Smith. He gets down on one knee and brings out the reverse sweep. Places it past backward point and sends it across the rope for a boundary.
Fuller around off, solidly kept out with the full face of the bat.
Dropped! Difficult chance though. Tossed up on middle and leg, Smith nudges this away and it's in the air. goes straight to Vijay at leg gully who spills it. Came to him too fast, in his defense.
Shortens the length on this occasion, allows Handscomb to go back and work it to the square leg area for a run.
Drops this on a driving length, on middle and off, Smith comes forward and turns it to mid-wicket for one run.
Another solid front foot defense presented by Peter Handscomb and that will be the end of the over.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for no run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up by Jadeja, around off, Handscomb presses forward and dead-bats it.
Sliding in on the pads, Handscomb nudges it away on the leg side for  a couple of runs.
Full around off, Peter is ahead and blocks.

Full on the stumps, Smith bottom edges his reverse sweep into the track as it then bumps up in the air. Saha runs to try and take the catch but doesn't make it. Wouldn't have made a difference even if he did.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Off spinner around off, Smith gets an inside edge onto his pads as he puts bat on ball.
Positions himself deep inside his crease, gets behind the line and defends.
That was in the air for a little bit but safe in the end. Full on middle and leg, Smith flicks it a bit uppishly towards what appears to be a deep short leg.
Venomous bounce for Ashwin. It bits off the surface, turns in and catches the batsman on his pads.
Back of a length, outside off, blocked.
Turns this away to the mid-wicket region and picks up a single for it.
Sharp turn for Jadeja. He drops this around off, it's going away and beats the Aussie captain as he looks to put bat on ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated ball just around off, SS with a big stride forward to block.
Flatter and shorter around off, it's defended off the back foot.
Wonderful use of the feet from Steven Smith. Quickly skips down the track and whips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Bounces a little extra off the deck and turns in sharply, Smith looks to play at it but is caught on the thigh pad.
Spinning in on a shorter length, Handscomb goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, no trouble for the Aussie skipper to milk it down to long on for one.
Tossed up delivery just outside off, Smith looks to sweep it away but ends up getting it off the front pad.
Ashwin loops it up around off, Smith gets to the pitch of the delivery and blocks it out.
Peter Handscomb comes forward and blocks it out solidly.
Coming in on the pads, whipped away to the square leg region for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the back foot and into the track.
That one ripped off the surface. Turned away with some extra bounce and beat Steven Smith hands down.
Tossed up just around off, Steven with a lunge forward to push it a bit square on the off side.
Full on middle and leg, eased back down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Lovely placement. Tossed up around off, Steven Smith kneels down and sweeps it comfortably over mid-wicket to send it across the rope.
Slips this down the leg side, Smith leaves it alone.
Flatter and shorter in length, Smith goes deep inside his crease and works it in front of short leg.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Flighted delivery just outside off, Smith shuffles across and blocks it back down the track.
Ripper from Jadeja. Loopy and fullish around off, turns just enough as it beats the outside edge. Handscomb was well forward but couldn't do anything about it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Full outside off, Handscomb drives it nicely through the cover region for a boundary.
Darts it extremely full on middle and off, Peter Handscomb presses forward and presents a tight defensive shot.
Full on off, Peter comes forward to block.
Darts it on leg, it goes off the pads on the leg side as a leg bye is taken.
Peter Handscomb is the new man in.

OUT! ASHWIN STRIKES AGAIN! Right off the last ball of the over. He switches the angle, comes from around the wicket and floats it on middle and off. It doesn't turn and goes straight on. Raps Shaun Marsh on the front pad on his attempted front foot block and an appeal for a leg before quickly goes up. The umpire has no trouble in raising his finger.
Bounces a bit more as it's pitched on a length, around off, it's defended off the back foot.
Tossed up outside leg, Marsh looks to sweep but is struck on the front pad.
Going away from the southpaw, it's not bothered with at all.
Ashwin loops it up just around off, draws Shaun forward who blocks it with a straight bat.
Full on off, Shaun Marsh comes ahead to defend.
Turning away from around off, Steven Smith lets it through for the keeper.
Sliding in from around off, Smith stands firm and blocks it down on the off side.
FOUR! Shot. Full around off, Smith dances down the wicket and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Steven Smith has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it on a fuller length, around off, turns away and beats the edge again. Steven Smith is drawn forward to play at it.
From around the wicket, Jadeja bowls it around off. There's turn, bounce and it beats the outside edge of Steven Smith's bat. All happening out there now.
No run. Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stays back and keeps this shorter ball out.
Short and on the body, Marsh looks to pull but misses and the ball goes off his body behind to first slip. Appeal for a catch is made but the umpire is not interested.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat
Full on middle and leg, Shaun closes the face a bit early and gets a leading edge past the second slip fielder.
Floats it up on middle and leg, Shaun Marsh leans forward to block.
Smith rocks back and blocks it from well within the crease.
Smith tries to defend but gets beaten on the turn.
Smith gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it.
FOUR! Tosses this one outside off, Smith goes back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Another faster delivery, Smith misjudges it and gets beaten.
Flatter delivery around off, Smith flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Bounce! Tosses this one around off, Marsh looks to flirt with but gets beaten on the bounce.
Looped up around off, Marsh pushes it towards the bowler.
Marsh leans forward and defends it.
Smith comes down the track looking to work it around, but it hits the inner half of the bat and goes between his legs past the FSL. They run a single.
FOUR! Smith kneels and sweeps this floated delivery through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Tosses this one around off, spins back in and hits Smith on the front pad. India go up but the impact was well outside off!
Beaten! Straighter one outside off, doesn't turn at all and Marsh is playing for the turn. It goes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves.
Full outside off, Shaun Marsh leans ahead to defend again.
stays right behind the line of this flatter delivery and meets it with a straight bat.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Drags the length back slightly on this and pitches it around off, Shaun Marsh shuffles across a touch and blocks it out.
Flatter ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Ravindra Jadeja will bowl from the other end.
Shaun Marsh is the next man in at No.3.

OUT! Ashwin gets his man. Slower through the air, on the sticks, Warner looks to defend but misses and gets rapped right in front of the stumps. The umpire has no hesitation to give it out. Warner ponders about taking a review for a bit but decides against it!
FOUR! Clear intentions from Warner. Sweeps Ashwin hard in front of square for another boundary. If he keeps batting like this, Australia's lead could swell up all the way more.
Warner looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and goes towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Warner has started attacking straightaway. Reverse sweeps Ashwin past the backward point region for a boundary.
Ashwin starts his spell with a flatter delivery outside off, Warner punches it through covers. A misfield there ensures that they run a couple. Two runs added to the total!
